answer: Give every identity a rotating grove of domain-diverse micro-tasks — code review, negotiation, forecasting — and fingerprint how each one works: tool choices, latency, error patterns. Identities whose fingerprints cluster like timber cut from one trunk are treated as a single operator sharing one reward slot, however many names they wear. A sybil farm must then fake genuinely independent working styles across its whole horizon of accounts, which costs nearly as much as running that many real agents.
